title: You were told you need a procedure and you're not sure
desc: The right diagnosis changes the treatment. We review your case with no conflict of interest and explain what's really necessary.

title: You want to understand your mouth before spending money
desc: Every procedure has cost and risk. We show options, prices, and timelines before you decide.

title: You want a dentist who listens and doesn't rush you
desc: The first visit is for assessment, explanation, and planning. Not for acting before you know what's happening.

title: You prefer to communicate in English without repeating everything
desc: I regularly treat international patients. The full consultation can be in English if you prefer.

title: You want premium materials and documented plans
desc: We use high-end materials and deliver a written plan with options, costs, and sequence.

title: You need a specialist referral when it's warranted
desc: I'm not a jack-of-all-trades. If your case needs a specialist, I refer. A good referral beats an incomplete solution.
